scope.evidence: Classical collinear acoustics on the forward-crossing branch (u_o >= -v) with subsonic source (-v < u_s < v), common medium frame, and no endpoint crossing in the modeled interval. The reverse-order branch (u_o < -v) is deferred as needing separate magnitude/branch treatment, not claimed impossible. Relativistic Doppler, noncollinear geometry, shock regimes, observer wake effects, and all energy/intensity/loudness/pitch relations excluded. The comoving zero-shift identity sits inside the branch. Conditional theoretical scope, clearly bounded.

source-fidelity.evidence: Live-inspected UP1 Sec 17.7: general law f_o = f_s (v +/- v_o)/(v -/+ v_s) with top signs for approach (Eq 17.20), plus Eqs 17.18-17.19, Table 17.4, and Example 17.8 confirmed. The signed mapping u_s=+v_s toward observer and u_o=+v_o toward source is documented and maps both sign branches exactly. The observer derivation before Eq 17.19 (wavelength equals observer travel plus wave travel over the arrival interval) imposes no subsonic upper bound on approach speed, so the r2 removal of the symmetric observer cap is source-supported. The zero-numerator reading at u_o=-v as a static-phase limit is labeled as a limiting inference from Sec 16.2 constant-phase tracking, distinguished from the sonic-source denominator singularity.

models.permitted_use: Theoretical use of f_o=f_s(v+u_o)/(v-u_s) for collinear classical acoustic Doppler on the forward-crossing branch (subsonic source, u_o>=-v, SI Hz and m/s); educational and wave-kinematics computations only.
